full_name: Sara Bleich | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Medicine Carol K. Pforzheimer Professor Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
bio: Sara Bleich is working on a several ongoing projects, including evaluations of the Philadelphia beverage tax, the changing restaurant environment on obesity risk, and novel strategies to reduce sugary beverage consumption, while also beginning a series of new projects that aim to improve nutrition among participants in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (formerly food stamps).
